The '''Bakura system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]], located within the [[Bakura sector/Legends|Bakura sector]] in the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]].<ref name="TEA" />
